description: Verification test that confirms trust_synthesiser_v2.py correctly reads injection_resilience dimension from mcp_signal_scores table and applies weight 1.6 with threshold 0.80 as specified in Phase 8 spec. Query mcp_signal_scores WHERE dimension='injection_resilience' for any 3 server records; assert score exists and is in [0.0, 100.0]. Parse the source of trust_synthesiser_v2.py to verify: (1) it imports signal_analyser_v2, (2) it queries mcp_signal_scores with dimension filter, (3) it applies composite weighting that includes injection_resilience. Output pass/fail for each check. If any check fails, set exit code 1 and report which specific condition failed.
